title: Science Needs Fair Rules in Conflict
title_zh: 冲突时期，科学合作需要公平规则
lead: Science often brings people together. But today, politics makes this hard. Two researchers say we need fair rules.
lead_zh: 科学常常把人们聚在一起。但如今，政治让这件事变得困难。两位研究者说，我们需要公平的规则。

paragraphs: Science is a way for people from many countries to work together. It helps us learn new things. But now, some countries do not agree. This makes science work difficult.

Two researchers wrote about this problem. Their names are Emmanuel Chidiebere Edeh and Ehizuelen Michael Mitchell Omoruyi. They work in China. One is at Shanghai University. The other is at Zhejiang Normal University.

body:
Science is a way for people from many countries to work together. It helps us learn new things. But now, some countries do not agree. This makes science work difficult.

Two researchers wrote about this problem. Their names are Emmanuel Chidiebere Edeh and Ehizuelen Michael Mitchell Omoruyi. They work in China. One is at Shanghai University. The other is at Zhejiang Normal University.

They say a new problem is growing. Where a scientist works can become a political sign. This is not fair. Science should not be about politics.

The researchers say we need fair rules. These rules can help scientists work together during conflicts. Science should stay open for everyone.
